title: Prescribed Force Trajectories as Benchmarks for Longitudinal EMG Decoding: Reproducibility Archive
description: Reproducibility archive for Prescribed Force Trajectories as Benchmarks for Longitudinal EMG Decoding. Includes the complete single-author manuscript LaTeX, four original vector figure PDFs, frozen study summaries, executable physical-time protocol-prior and independently reconstructed EMG/Ridge/Kalman analyses, and full-data validation ZIPs from the original 220 CEMHSEY Part-I recordings. Six of six EMG/hybrid cohort medians agree with historical summaries within 0.0005 in R-squared. All six Figure-4 component contrasts are supported by an independent normalized-time reconstruction; documented differences include Subject 5 (eight-electrode selected alpha) and the eight-electrode adaptive-variance bootstrap CI upper bound. The original historical executable was not recovered; the new reconstruction's numerical choices are documented.
